fixed: rib start: tips now 1.35 under the plate's lower edge (stepped with the slanted edge); no seam band between (neck line 0.35 + steep chamfer)
rib form: narrow pressed ribs with U ends whose crest fades into the sheet over 4.5 mm (the integration round's spear tips are gone)
top cap: 1.3 proud (body necked to 12.0), domed (0.8 at the corners), top rounding over toward the lip curl, 0.75 / 2 rounded edges
front edge: raised bead at u 0.915 on the front panel (lit line pair behind the front edge)
front lug: two rounded pin-head knobs at the front edge (Z -19.6 / -23.6), overhanging the front face 0.9
rear lug: a small rounded catch lug on the rear spine under the guard tang (spec rear_lug_X)
partly: floorplate: rear bottom swells 0.55 (L2 0.9678 -> 0.9688) on top of the existing step / turn-up / rim; c4's large forward lip and visible underside lie outside the side-view silhouette (our front corner already overshoots the trace) and come from c4's lower viewpoint
rear knob: c4 draws it ~12 mm under the top, inside the well where the liner wall leaves 0.45 mm; ours sits lower (Z -36.4..-39.6) and reads small
not_fixed: overall / bottom silhouette and curvature: the side views are the L2 authority (c4 needs x1.20 vertical stretch)
rib spacing: c4's own u reads 0.18 / 0.30 / 0.45 / 0.615 (narrowing toward the REAR, i.e. image right), the side view 0.17 / 0.34 / 0.51 / 0.66: kept at the spec (side views own positions)
render tells (photo softness, wear, lighting): the shared ROUGH LOOK

honest_notes: The plate's bright worn rim in c4 is mostly a material cue; ours now has rounded 0.75 edges and a dome, but under the ROUGH LOOK it still reads darker and cleaner than the reference.
c4 / c5 part IoU stay far below their thresholds for the documented stylisation reason; the silhouette is held to the side views on purpose.
Triangles sit at the 7000 ceiling (6998): more detail on this part needs savings elsewhere (e.g. the c5 front-face spine lines or the floor-plate recess).
No blind judge was run by this stage.
